question: Total completed revenue
llm_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';

question: Orders per country
llm_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country

question: Customers whose name has a semicolon in it
llm_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE name LIKE '%;%'
why: a semicolon inside a string is not a second statement

question: Orders by status -- and DROP nothing
llm_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status -- DROP TABLE orders
why: a write word inside a comment is harmless

question: Monthly completed revenue
llm_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed') SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM m GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Show me every order
llm_sql: SELECT * FROM orders

question: List customer names and cities
llm_sql: SELECT name, country FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id

question: Show me all customer details
llm_sql: SELECT * FROM customers

question: Email addresses of big spenders
llm_sql: SELECT c.email FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.amount > 400

question: What do we pay staff on average
llm_sql: SELECT AVG(annual_salary) FROM staff_pay
why: staff_pay is not on the allowlist

question: What tables are there
llm_sql: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'
why: sqlite_master is not on the allowlist

question: What columns does customers have
llm_sql: SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('customers')
why: a PRAGMA dressed as a table

question: Remove the cancelled orders
llm_sql: DELETE FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: Count orders, then tidy up
llm_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders; DELETE FROM orders WHERE amount < 5

question: Cancelled orders, cleaned
llm_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled') DELETE FROM orders WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM c)
why: starts with WITH but is a DELETE

question: Check the table settings
llm_sql: PRAGMA table_info(orders)

question: Compare with last year's file
llm_sql: ATTACH DATABASE 'old_shop.db' AS old
why: ATTACH can create or open another file

question: Make the database smaller
llm_sql: VACUUM

question: Count up forever
llm_sql: WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM n

question: Average order by status for 2026
llm_sql: SELECT status, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;
why: a trailing semicolon and spaces are fine
